banner.title: embedding-gpu
banner.tagline: Serves a local 1024-dimension embedding model from the shared Arc B70, behind a LiteLLM rate cap.

explainer.title: One embedder, sharing a card with chat

steps.title: Load
steps.text: The HelmRelease starts llama-server with the Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B GGUF at f16. The weights land on a 5 Gi claim, so a restart does not fetch them again.
steps.scene: a model file sliding into a slot on a card

steps.title: Share
steps.text: The pod takes one devic.es/b70 token on the single Arc B70. Chat holds the card's memory, so the embedder only gets what chat leaves.
steps.scene: two tenants sharing one circuit board

steps.title: Embed
steps.text: POST /v1/embeddings runs with last-token pooling, two parallel slots and a 512-token context, one vector per input.
steps.scene: text tokens flowing into a vector bar

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Readiness and liveness send a probe and fail on a null or all-zero vector. A NaN embedding returns HTTP 200 with a green /health, so /health alone is not enough.
steps.scene: a probe passing through a filter

steps.title: Throttle
steps.text: LiteLLM caps embedding-local at 60 requests a minute and 8 in flight. Excess calls get an immediate 429 instead of queueing on the card.

art.about: a local embedding server that shares one GPU with a chat model and is rate-limited by a proxy
art.title: How embedding-gpu serves vectors on a shared card
